messages:
Nora Banks: Heads-up: got two Marketplace->SI leads for HelixHealth that conflicted today. We need a concise rules-of-engagement doc so partner ops doesn't arbitrate every time.
Diego Alvarez: Ugh. Is this the situation where the SI claims and field says they owned the account?
Nora Banks: Exactly. SI claimed via intake form, field said they had a prior intro 9 months ago.
Hana Kim: Proposal: adopt a tiered claim priority. 1) if lead.origin == 'marketplace' -> SI priority for 21 days. 2) if SFDC shows field opportunity with stage not == 'closed' in last 12 months -> field priority. 3) for deals > $300k -> require signed "Co-sell MOU" in SFDC before SI outreach.
Diego Alvarez: 21 days feels tight. Why not 30?
Hana Kim: Want to limit long lockouts for field. Many SIs move fast on implementation bookings. But fine with 30 if ops prefers.
PartnerOpsBot: Note: created ticket POPS-217 to add a claim_reason field to intake so we can surface origin more clearly.
Samir Rao: Can we also add an account-mapping check so if SFDC has duplicate parent accounts we automatically pick the most-recently-modified as canonical for claim resolution?
Nora Banks: Yes — add that. Also add a fallback: if ambiguity persists after mapping, partner ops has 48 hours to adjudicate before system defaults to field.
Diego Alvarez: Sounds reasonable. Who owns rolling this out into the queue logic?
Hana Kim: I'll pair with eng to update queue rules. Nora, can you add the playbook blurb and the MOU template link?
Nora Banks: On it. Will post draft by EOD and ping for review.
PartnerOpsBot: Automated reminder set: POPS-217 watchers will be pinged when mapping field is added.
Nora Banks: Thanks team. Meeting in 2 days if needed, otherwise we'll iterate in doc. :sparkles:
